note: Checked by hand from the linked official documents on the date shown. Not refreshed automatically: re-check when a notification changes.

us_301_india.label: US extra duty on goods from India (Section 301, forced-labour action)
us_301_india.source: USTR notice, Federal Register 91 FR 47318 (28 Jul 2026), doc 2026-15181
us_301_india.detail: 10% on goods of India entered on or after 24 Jul 2026, subject to the notice's Annex I/II exemptions. Trade summaries (labgrowndiamondsupplier.com, citing GJEPC) say lab-grown diamonds from India pay this 10%; check the annex or your customs broker for your exact goods.

us_mfn_7104_91_10.label: US base (MFN) duty, cut lab-grown diamonds for jewellery (HTS 7104.91.10)
us_mfn_7104_91_10.detail: Free. Rough synthetic diamonds (7104.21.00) 3%. Total on cut LGD from India = 0% + 10% = 10% of customs value.

us_301_others.label: Same Section 301 duty on China, Hong Kong, UAE, Thailand, Israel and most other investigated economies
us_301_others.detail: China also pays its older 7.5% Section 301 tariff on this heading (htslookup.com summary of CBP rates). India's 10% is lower than most competing origins.

dgvcl_htp1.label: DGVCL power tariff, HT industrial (HTP-I), energy charge
dgvcl_htp1.source: GERC tariff schedule for DGVCL, MGVCL, PGVCL, UGVCL, effective 1 Apr 2026 (tariff order case 2581/2025, 25 Mar 2026)
dgvcl_htp1.detail: Excludes demand charges, FPPAS (fuel surcharge, changes during the year), electricity duty and taxes; take those from your bill. Rates read from the GERC schedule as summarised at konduktor.in/gujarat-electricity-tariff; the GERC PDF could not be opened from our server, so check your own bill.
dgvcl_htp1.tod: Peak-hour (7-11 am, 6-10 pm) +0.45 ₹/kWh up to 500 kVA, +0.85 above; energy used 11 am-5 pm -0.60 ₹/kWh.

gjepc_release.label: When new data comes
gjepc_release.detail: GJEPC publishes each month's export review around the 7th-15th of the next month (Oct 2026 report dated 9 Nov 2026). The app checks daily; the call changes only when a new month arrives.
